summary.name: Pastebot
summary.one_liner: Pastebot is a clipboard manager for the Mac that keeps a searchable history of copied items and lets you store, filter, and re-paste them.
use_cases: Find and re-paste something copied earlier
Store frequently used snippets in custom pastebins
Paste multiple copied items in sequence
Automate clipboard access from scripts or the terminal
summary.what_it_does: Pastebot runs a running history of everything copied so items can be found and pasted again. Users can organize clippings into custom pastebins and rule-based smart pastebins. Custom filters can be applied before pasting, and Stacks allow copying several items and pasting them one after another. Features include iCloud Sync, per-clipping keyboard shortcuts, app and content blacklists, a spacebar preview window, Universal Clipboard integration with iPhone, and access via Apple Shortcuts or a command-line tool.
notable: Filters and Stacks for applying transformations and pasting sequences
iCloud Sync and Universal Clipboard integration with iPhone
Also sold via the Mac App Store with a subscription option
caveats: Paid: $39 USD one-time license with one year of updates, or $24.99/year or $2.99/month subscription via the App Store; a 14-day free trial is offered
Pastebot 2 is a separate older download
